integrity: Proof supplied for all stated fields and primes, with independently executable finite checks as corroboration rather than universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Full Smith diagonal proved for prime fields only; char-p rank for arbitrary prime powers; classical Jacobi-sum magnitudes used without originality claim. Priority relative to all possible incidence-scheme reformulations remains uncertain.
title: Exact modular ranks and prime-field Smith forms for toric affine line tomography
